title: What items do
description:
Describe item effects as data and apply them to the player.

```
potion: heal 10            -> hp 20 -> 30 (max 30)
elixir: heal 50, max +10   -> max 40, hp 40
cursed ring: speed -1      -> speed 2
unknown effect "fly" -> reported, ignored
```
hints: Apply `max_hp` before `heal` in the elixir, which is why order matters.
requirements: Items have a list of `(effect, amount)` pairs.
Effects apply in order; print the stats before and after.
stretch: Add effects that last a number of turns.
